Content: Researchers wanted to investigate whether babies have a sense of right and wrong. They showed each of `60` babies a puppet show in which a red puppet was trying to open a heavy box lid. D.Choice: The random assignment of color to role allows the researchers to determine if `text(one)` color is better than another in teaching babies right from wrong.

E.Choice: Boys and girls might prefer different colors. The random assignment of color to role ensures that the show is equally accessible to boys and girls.
